description.en: The view is close to a wooden door or cabinet door; at frame B, patterned carpet and dark furniture are visible on the left, but no straight passage through a dining room or a kitchen doorway is shown.

uncertainties.zh: B 帧左侧的花纹地毯和深色家具属于走廊还是另一房间尚不能仅凭该帧确定；本段是否完全离开卧室也不明确。
uncertainties.en: Whether the patterned carpet and dark furniture on the left at frame B belong to a hallway or another room cannot be determined from that frame alone, and it is also unclear whether this segment fully leaves the bedroom.

progress.zh: 截至 B：已沿走廊继续前进，途中左侧为白色玻璃装饰柜，右侧可见白色扶手椅/沙发的一部分，并已左转穿过门口进入餐厅入口内侧；当前入口左侧近处为电视、矮柜和绿植。尚未确认沿餐厅直行时左侧餐桌椅的情况，也未到达通往厨房的门口。
progress.en: As of B: the robot has continued along the hallway, with the white glass-front curio cabinet on the left and part of a white armchair/sofa visible on the right, and has turned left through the doorway into the dining-room entrance. Just inside on the left are a television, a low cabinet, and a plant. It is not yet confirmed whether the dining table and chairs have been passed on the left while walking straight through the dining room, and the doorway leading to the kitchen has not been reached.
